meta.title: nm to µm Converter — Nanometer to Micrometer
meta.description: Convert Nanometer (nm) to Micrometer (µm) instantly. 1 nm = 0.001 µm. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert nanometers (nm) to micrometers (µm) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each nanometer equals 0.001 micrometers. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One nanometer is equal to **0.001 micrometers**. To go the other way, one micrometer equals **1000 nanometers**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> micrometers = nanometers × 0.001

Worked example — converting 10 nanometers:

10 × 0.001 = **0.01 µm**.

To invert, divide by 0.001 (or multiply by 1000).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 nm ≈ 0.001 µm. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Nanometer and Micrometer both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many micrometers are in 1 nanometer?
**A:** 0.001 micrometers.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert nm to µm?
**A:** micrometers = nanometers × 0.001.

**Q:** How do I convert µm back to nm?
**A:** Multiply by 1000 (or divide by 0.001).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this nm to µm converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
